description: Generates a FRACTAL WAVE from a single (mono) input WAVECYCLE: the shape datafile's time/MIDI-pitch contour is applied as a transposition pattern over its own duration, then recursively over every resulting sub-unit, sub-sub-unit, etc., down to the smallest wavelength - self-similar pitch structure grown from one cycle of audio. Output duration is set by dur (3.0 -> 3.007710 s, +0.26% quantized up to whole pattern units). HANG LANDMINE (first-class, build-pinned): a 2-POINT shape file ('0 0 / 0.5 7') sends both wave modes into an apparent INFINITE LOOP (no output, killed only by timeout) - the final value is documented as ignored, leaving a single effective point. Shapes need AT LEAST 3 breakpoints (a 3-point shape returning to 0 verified working); the engine's subprocess timeout is the guard. The input should be a WAVECYCLE - a short mono segment starting and ending at sample value 0 (waveform make is the companion tool that cuts exactly this from any source); behavior on arbitrary long material is unpinned in this mode (that is mode 1's job, uncurated - its output duration is strongly shape-dependent: a 1 s tone contracted to 0.188 s under a 3-point shape). Optional maxfrac/str/warp flags are banner-documented, unprobed and uncurated. Sibling: fractal spectrum (spectral-domain transposition fractal) is unprobed.
musical_use: A wavetable synth with self-similar pitch DNA: cut one cycle from any sound (waveform make 2), write a small pitch contour, and the render extrudes that contour into every timescale at once - the same melodic shape audible as phrase, as figuration, and as timbre. Small intervals (2-5 semitones over the pattern) give braided, arpeggio-like tones; wide contours go clangorous as the recursion stacks transpositions. The wavecycle's own colour survives as the grain of the texture - a vocal cycle sounds vocal, a string cycle stringy. Use dur freely (duration is set, not grown); layer renders from different source cycles with the same shape for ensembles that share one gesture. Keep shapes >= 3 points (the 2-point hang) and start/end values matched for loopable seams.

shape.description: REQUIRED breakpoint textfile of time/MIDI-pitch pairs (mode 2 semantics; range 0-127 per banner) defining the largest fractal pattern; times start at 0 and increase, the final time sets the pattern length, the final VALUE is ignored. AT LEAST 3 POINTS: 2-point shapes hang the program in an infinite loop on this build (engine timeout guards). Write via write_data_file.

dur.description: Output duration in seconds (banner: max 2 hours; curated max 7200). Quantized up slightly to whole pattern units (3.0 -> 3.0077, +0.26%). Required.

examples.description: Grow a texture from one 100 Hz cycle with a small three-note shape.
examples.expected_use: Input: a single wavecycle (use waveform make 2 first). write_data_file('shape3.txt', '0 60\n0.25 65\n0.5 60'). Self-similar arpeggiation at every timescale.

known_issues: 2-POINT SHAPE = INFINITE LOOP (this build): both fractal wave modes spin forever producing no output; only the timeout kills them. Always write >= 3 breakpoints. Marked stability 'unstable' for this trap.

Input must be MONO and should be a true wavecycle (starts/ends at 0) - waveform make 2 produces exactly the right material. Long arbitrary inputs belong to mode 1 (uncurated; its output duration is shape-dependent and unpredictable - observed 0.19x contraction).
Duration quantizes up to whole pattern units (+0.26% observed at 3 s).
maxfrac (-m), str (-t), warp (-i), -s and -o flags are banner-documented but unprobed - uncurated.
Sibling fractal spectrum (fractalise a spectrum by transposition) unprobed this tranche.
